page_title: CAG 1-1 NAP | Cagliari v Napoli 25/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' 1 - 1 Goal Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari)! Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) was put through by Alberto Dossena and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the top right corner. 1:1.

90+5' What a great effort! Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) decides to unleash a long-range shot. Despite hitting it very well, it scorches inches wide of the right post. We could have witnessed a magnificent goal. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
90+5' A quickly taken corner by Napoli.

90+4' Giovanni Simeone (Napoli) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Simone Scuffet inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball into the right side of the target, but was denied by a great save. It will be a corner kick for Napoli.
90+2' A spell of possession for Napoli in an attempt to control the game.
90+1' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.

90' CHANCE! Jens Cajuste finds Matteo Politano (Napoli) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the left post! The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
89' 4:2 – these are the offside statistics for both sides in this match.
86' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
85' Here is a change. Pasquale Mazzocchi is going off and Francesco Calzona gives the last tactical orders to Leo Ostigard (Napoli).
85' Problems for Francesco Calzona as Victor Osimhen (Napoli) is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Giovanni Simeone replaces him.
85' The injury to Victor Osimhen (Napoli) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
81' Gabriele Zappa receives a sweet cross inside the box from Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
79' Substitution. Jesper Lindstrom (Napoli) on for Giacomo Raspadori.
79' Francesco Calzona has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jens Cajuste (Napoli) replacing Piotr Zielinski.
79' A player from Cagliari commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Napoli, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
76' Gaetano Oristanio (Cagliari) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Tommaso Augello.
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Petagna (Cagliari) is coming onto the pitch as Leonardo Pavoletti cannot continue after picking up an injury.
74' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) creates space for himself on the edge of the box and smacks a hard shot towards the middle of the goal, but it's an easy save for Alex Meret.
73' Francesco Calzona decides to make a substitution. Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) will be replaced by Matteo Politano.
71' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) picks up an injury.
71' Looks like Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
70' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
68' The whistle blows and Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is booked for an infringement.
68' Victor Osimhen (Napoli) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
66' 0 - 1 Goal! Victor Osimhen (Napoli) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Giacomo Raspadori and easily beat the keeper with a header into the bottom left corner from close range. 0:1.
65' A brilliant cross into the box finds Victor Osimhen (Napoli), who directs his header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
65' Napoli take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
61' Substitution. Leonardo Pavoletti (Cagliari) replaces Gianluca Lapadula.
61' Claudio Ranieri has decided to substitute Gianluca Gaetano and he is replaced by Nicolas Viola (Cagliari).
61' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Gabriele Zappa.
60' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
59' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
58' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
57' Luca Pairetto blows his whistle after Alberto Dossena (Cagliari) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Napoli are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
55' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
54' Napoli are seeing far more of the ball now.
51' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
50' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play. Cagliari are awarded a corner kick.
49' Zito Luvumbo rounds off a good move with a layoff to Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) inside the box, he has a clear sight of goal but sends the ball just wide of the left post.
48' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
47' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) swings it in and Gianluca Lapadula gets on the end of it, but Alex Meret shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.

45+3' Nahitan Nandez sends over a penetrating corner which finds the head of Alberto Dossena (Cagliari), but his effort from close range is disappointing and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
45+3' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
44' Alex Meret (Napoli) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
43' The game is interrupted now, Alex Meret (Napoli) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

43' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) reacts well and displays good awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. His effort misses the right post by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

40' Victor Osimhen passes to Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli), but he produces a wild shot from the edge of the box which goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
38' The percentage of ball possession is – 26:74.
36' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
35' The goal by Cagliari won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
33' Wait a minute! The referee has decided to review the goal using the VAR system.
32' It's an own goal! Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) beats his own goalkeeper.
32' Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari) takes a direct free kick.
32' Referee Luca Pairetto sees the trip by Pasquale Mazzocchi (Napoli) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Cagliari are awarded a free kick.
31' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) plays a long ball to Victor Osimhen, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
29' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a cross in and finds Victor Osimhen inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in and clears the danger.

28' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
28' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
27' Some patient build-up play from Napoli as they look to unlock the defence.

24' What a save from Alex Meret! Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant save to keep it out.
23' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
23' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Cagliari will have a corner.
22' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
21' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
20' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Cagliari comes to nothing.
19' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Jakub Jankto (Cagliari), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders. Cagliari will take a corner kick.

19' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Luca Pairetto with no other option than to blow for a foul. Cagliari are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

16' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) receives a lofted pass in the goal area and unleashes a dangerous header which sails narrowly wide of the right post! The ball goes out of play and Napoli will have a goal kick.
14' Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Napoli.

13' A through ball from Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) fails to reach Victor Osimhen as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Victor Osimhen could have got into a promising position.
12' Juan Jesus (Napoli) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Luca Pairetto signals. Cagliari have a free kick.
11' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' The free kick is taken by Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli), but ball is cleared. It's going to be a corner kick.
9' Napoli are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
8' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) sends a low pass into the box, towards Victor Osimhen. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
6' Juan Jesus (Napoli) tries to find Mathias Olivera, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
5' Nahitan Nandez (Cagliari) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem.
4' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Napoli.
3' Jakub Jankto (Cagliari) takes the free kick which is dealt with by the opposition defence.
2' Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) commits a foul during an attacking move. Napoli get a free kick.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Cagliari will have the kick-off.
Luca Pairetto was nominated as the referee for this game.
